title: Tesla and Marconi claimed alien communication

tellings.quote: So Tesla and Maronei claimed alien communication.

plain: The inventors Nikola Tesla and Guglielmo Marconi, both pioneers of radio, are said to have claimed they picked up messages from aliens. Michels mentions it in passing, in his own words, while talking with the filmmaker Tim Alberino, and gives no source or details. If true, contact may have been made in the early days of radio.
